hotels.title: Central Coast Waterfront Bliss: One- & Two-Bedroom Suites & Studios Steps from Ettalong Beach
hotels.description: Your dreams of beachfront bliss will come true on the tranquil shores of New South Wales’ Central Coast, where your next relaxing escape awaits. Immerse yourself in the enchanting coastal lifestyle from a collection of suites with private balconies and spa baths, offering all your home comforts in a stunning location. Start each day at one of the beach’s charming cafes and savour your morning coffee before setting off to explore hidden beaches or lounge poolside. The Central Coast is renowned for its fantastic mix of laid-back living and adventures among nature, from walking and cycling trails at Warrah Trig and Pearl Beach to the lookouts and beaches of nearby Bouddi National Park.
